title: Some keyboard shortcuts impossible when attempting to internationalize

review.reason: Reports that action overrides cannot express some shortcut mappings needed for international keyboard layouts. The body includes a long screenshot; it was not replayed. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A keyboard layout extension lead related to #9862; Varve's shortcut configuration and non-US layouts were not inspected.

title: Sync client throws when a message arrives on an orphaned websocket

review.reason: Reports that a late message from an old orphaned socket reaches a handler that asserts the socket must already be closing/closed, generating production errors. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship this shared tldraw sync client; no local WebSocket collaboration path was reproduced.

title: Sync client can stay 'online' while its websocket is still connecting, causing send failures

review.reason: Describes a reconnect path where state remains online after swapping in a new CONNECTING socket, so throttled document sends throw `InvalidStateError`. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No equivalent synchronized document websocket client exists in Varve's current collaboration stub.

title: Sync sessions are rejected with an unknown error when a client's v1 schema has no recordVersions

review.reason: The reply confirms #10220 makes `upgradeSchema` return a structured error for missing v1 recordVersions, which TLSyncRoom maps to a version-mismatch rejection instead of an unknown exception.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream sync protocol schema upgrade fix; Varve has no matching room/session service.

title: Sync reconnect manager crashes when the WebSocket global is undefined

review.reason: Reports reconnect/disconnect handlers dereferencing static WebSocket constants where the global constructor is undefined, producing errors in production. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns the upstream sync reconnect manager; Varve has no corresponding sync WebSocket client.

title: Dragging shapes crashes when a moving shape is deleted mid-drag

review.reason: The reply confirms #10171 skips shapes or drop targets deleted during translation instead of passing undefined into translate hooks. The trigger depends on remote collaboration deleting a selected shape mid-drag.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no live concurrent collaborators; no equivalent mid-drag external deletion was reproduced.

title: Laser tool crashes when its scribble session times out mid-stroke

review.reason: Describes a race between a fading laser scribble timeout and a delayed pointer/tick event that tries to continue a completed session. The report gives background-tab and throttled-browser triggers but no comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched Varve tool sources for a laser tool/session; no matching transient laser interaction exists.

title: Paste throws an unhandled rejection when the clipboard changes during read

review.reason: Reports an InvalidStateError from ClipboardItem.getType when clipboard contents change between listing MIME types and reading a type, escaping the paste flow as an unhandled promise rejection. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: `packages/editor/src/clipboard.ts` catches per-type getType failures and catches navigator.clipboard.read failures, preserving other MIME fallbacks; the reported rejection path is guarded in the inspected implementation.

title: Pasting tldraw content with unknown shape types crashes the editor

review.reason: Reports tldraw clipboard content carrying a shape type with no registered shape util, causing placement calculations to throw. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve clipboard parsing rejects unknown node kinds before state mutation (`parseClipboardNode` returns null and `parseClipboardData` rejects the fragment). Varve's clipboard schema has no tldraw shape-util dispatch.

title: Pasting content from a newer tldraw version crashes instead of showing an error

review.reason: Reports newer tldraw clipboard content failing migration with an uncaught error instead of an actionable paste error, affecting both hosted and desktop app versions. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's versioned clipboard parser accepts only declared historical/current format versions and returns null for unknown versions before paste; this inspection found no equivalent unchecked migration throw in the clipboard entrance.

title: Pasting Excalidraw drawings with custom stroke widths fails validation

review.reason: Reports an upstream Excalidraw converter mapping arbitrary strokeWidth to a four-value enum, producing undefined for unsupported widths. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched Varve editor import paths for an Excalidraw importer; none is present. Varve stores stroke weight as a numeric value rather than the upstream four-size enum.

title: Content with non-canonical fractional index keys crashes paste and file open

review.reason: Reports third-party-generated tldraw files/clipboard data with invalid fractional index keys failing schema validation during paste/import/open. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses a separate scene-array ordering model and versioned Varve document validators; it does not import tldraw fractional-index record keys. The `order` key is auxiliary metadata, not the authoritative node position.

title: Sync connect fails with 'Invalid string length' on very large room snapshots

review.reason: Reports a large-room full snapshot exceeding JavaScript string serialization limits in the hosted sync connect response, causing repeated reconnects for the affected desktop user. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not serialize a shared room snapshot over a sync connect response; no equivalent service limit applies.

title: Chunked sync messages are mis-assembled after a socket is replaced or the Durable Object wakes mid-message

review.reason: The sole comment says related malformed-chunk errors continued in the current release from Sep 24 to Oct 7, so the issue remains reported despite existing handling. This is the server's per-session chunk assembler across socket replacement and Durable Object sleep/wake.

varveAssessment.assessment: The protocol/server path is upstream sync infrastructure not implemented by Varve.

title: Rooms with a record over SQLite's size limit can't load into Durable Object storage

review.reason: Reports a large individual JSON record exceeding Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite's string/blob limit during migration from R2. This differs from an oversized total room, and no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite storage is not used by Varve's local document persistence.

title: OG thumbnail renders for shared files time out repeatedly

review.reason: Reports thousands of production Browser Rendering timeouts over months; the only comment says the issue remained the largest sync-worker incident with hundreds of repeated failures per day. This is a recurring service-availability problem rather than a single transient report.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not run the upstream hosted thumbnail queue or Cloudflare Browser Rendering service.

title: tldraw.com fails to load on browsers without Object.hasOwn

review.reason: The issue identifies unguarded module-load `Object.hasOwn` calls that blank the app on pre-Chrome 93/Safari 15.4/Firefox 92 browsers. The reply says the issue continued to affect users; no polyfill/fallback resolution is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's supported browser floor and module-load use of `Object.hasOwn` were not audited; applicability remains uncertain until compared against its compatibility policy.

title: Zero IndexedDB-missing errors surface as unhandled rejections

review.reason: Reports uncaught rejection when Zero's IndexedDB cache disappears at runtime after browser eviction, site-data clearing, or another tab/profile cleanup. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The cache belongs to the upstream Zero sync client. Varve's own offline persistence remains a separate durability surface and needs its own inspection.

title: tldraw UI renders in serif font when the host page sets no font family

review.reason: Reports SDK UI inheriting the browser's default serif font on a plain host page. The reply questions whether this is a real integration problem and values the visible contrast in a from-scratch demo, so the default sans-serif outcome is not accepted as an obvious fix.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve owns its own UI theme/font tokens and is not embedded as a tldraw SDK; no local font-family defect is established.

title: Deep review of @tldraw/state for bugs and performance improvements

review.reason: The issue rolls up state bugs (stale computed values, re-entrant/zero-dependency effects, nested rollback, async rollback, computed inheritance/first-derive errors, epoch diffs) plus an allocation optimization and docs. The reply confirms the split fixes merged. Several semantic questions were explicitly left unchanged; they are not included as solved defects.

varveAssessment.assessment: These behaviors belong to upstream @tldraw/state. Varve has distinct history and state systems; compare the specific semantic risks against local transactions/reactive providers before transferring fixes.

title: Deep review of sync and local persistence for correctness bugs

review.reason: Rolls up fixes for reconnect/socket races, version compatibility, wire chunking, transaction rollback, room/storage behavior, and local IndexedDB persistence. It includes an especially relevant local-persistence PR (#10102) for lost final edits and cross-tab edits during load; the split PRs require recursive evidence review before any Varve conclusion.

varveAssessment.assessment: Most listed work depends on upstream sync/server infrastructure. PR #10102 concerns client-side persistence durability and is queued for direct comparison with Varve's save/close/recovery lifecycle before disposition.

title: Simplify pass across packages, dotcom, and templates

review.reason: Tracks broad behavior-preserving cleanup split across editor, SDK, dotcom, state, commenting, Mermaid, and templates. The issue body marks some child PRs open and others merged/closed at C1; this is not evidence of functional defects or a license to mechanically refactor Varve code.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream repository cleanup inventory, not a finding that Varve's modules need the same refactors.

title: Deep review of the select tool and default tool states for bugs

review.reason: The rollup covers crop sessions, pointer cancellation, locked/rotated shapes, deleted shapes during gestures, clone cancellation, resize/handles and tool transitions. Its sole comment says every split PR merged or closed, with #10071 only a rebase note. This is a large source of concrete regression scenarios, but upstream implementation details and tests require per-PR review before Varve transfer.

varveAssessment.assessment: The user-visible failure modes are relevant to Varve's canvas interaction surface, but each must be compared with its existing pointer/crop/transform invariant and real-interaction coverage rather than imported mechanically.

title: Deep review of the default shape utils and shape tools for bugs

review.reason: Rolls up fixes across text, tool state, arrows, freehand, lines, geometry, images/video, frames, embeds, and bookmarks, with cases including rotated/scaled parents, degenerate geometry, stale caches, and cancellation. Each child PR is a distinct evidence node; no aggregate conclusion substitutes for reviewing the relevant fixes/tests.

varveAssessment.assessment: Highly relevant regression-scenario source for Varve's draw, arrow, frame, crop, text and media workflows. Individual linked PRs and their tests need review to identify truly shared failure modes and local validation gaps.

title: Deep review of @tldraw/store for correctness bugs

review.reason: Rolls up regression-backed fixes for transaction rollback visibility, undo correctness, reactive subscriptions, atom/map behavior, migrations, and schema handling. The split child fixes are distinct evidence and are not considered verified from the parent summary alone.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not embed @tldraw/store, but its document store/history/reactivity are analogous correctness boundaries. Child fixes and tests should be inspected against the Varve engine before concluding there is no shared regression risk.

title: Reference docs treat @tldraw/editor React components as variables and functions

review.reason: The tldraw API generator skips React component exports from @tldraw/editor and emits misleading variable/function reference pages. This concerns the upstream SDK documentation generator and its package model.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no published tldraw-compatible React SDK reference generator; its Astro documentation describes Varve product workflows.

title: Add reference docs for the commenting, mentions, collaboration, and sync-collaboration packages

review.reason: Requests reference pages for tldraw commenting, mentions, collaboration, and sync-collaboration packages. These APIs are specific to upstream packages not shipped by Varve.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship the four tldraw collaboration packages. Its local-first product has no direct reference-page gap matching these exports.

title: Docs link checker accepts wrong-case heading anchors that are dead on the rendered page

review.reason: The tldraw docs checker lowercases fragments and heading IDs although rendered heading IDs preserve case, allowing dead links to pass. The issue identifies a concrete docs-tooling defect that should be compared with Varve’s own anchor validator.

varveAssessment.assessment: scripts/audit-docs.mjs lowercases Markdown heading slugs and link fragments; the Astro search extractor likewise lowercases generated heading IDs. Both relevant Varve surfaces therefore match their rendered slug convention. No matching case-sensitive-heading mismatch was found.

title: Remove the stale add-framer-rewrites script and workflow

review.reason: Reports an obsolete Framer sitemap workflow that can restore removed rewrites into the tldraw docs app. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Repository search found no Framer rewrite workflow, stale Framer sitemap script, or matching `add-framer-rewrites` command in Varve.

title: Deep review of the docs app for correctness bugs

review.reason: Aggregates reference-page collisions, sidebar/navigation, link checking, keyboard shortcut, feedback tracking, bundle-size, dead-code, and dependency fixes in the tldraw docs app. The linked child issues remain separate evidence nodes.

varveAssessment.assessment: The case-sensitive anchor-checking scenario was compared against scripts/audit-docs.mjs and the Astro heading slugger: both generate lowercase heading IDs and compare lowercase fragments. Other tldraw docs-app findings refer to a different Next.js documentation architecture and are not imported into Varve.

title: Cancelled touch or pen pointer leaves the canvas stuck in a pointing state

review.reason: Reports canceled touch/pen input leaving tool state active, then confirmed the fix in #10464; later comments note #10690 fixed a palm/pen interaction regression and that lostpointercapture was intentionally declined upstream. Varve has explicit pointercancel dispatch and lost-capture cleanup, but this batch is adding browser regression coverage for cancellation and recovery.

varveAssessment.assessment: packages/editor/src/canvas/inputPipeline.ts dispatches React pointercancel to the active tool, cancels the recorded interaction, clears pointer ownership, and separately handles lostpointercapture. Existing E2E covers multi-touch cancellation but not an OS-style pointercancel followed by a clean new draw; a focused Chromium regression was added and awaits verification.

title: TLSessionStateSnapshot's iOS detector disagrees with tlenv.isIos on iPadOS

review.reason: Reports two tldraw iOS detectors disagreeing on iPadOS Safari’s desktop user agent, affecting gesture listener selection and coalesced pointer events. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent central `isIos` switch controlling both gesture routing and coalesced canvas input; current touch/layout capability decisions are based on pointer capabilities. Device-specific iPadOS gesture validation remains outside this code comparison.

title: Safari pencil double-tap zoom suppression never runs because its touch listeners check instanceof PointerEvent

review.reason: The upstream hook registers touchstart/touchend listeners but checks for PointerEvent, so its intended Apple Pencil branch cannot run for TouchEvent. The issue itself leaves delete-versus-repair and device validation as a product decision.

varveAssessment.assessment: No matching Safari pencil double-tap suppression hook was found in Varve. Adding platform-specific suppression without real iPad Pencil validation would risk changing browser zoom/accessibility behavior, so this is recorded without a code change.

title: Shape styles and culling registration are lost when the ShapeWrapper component identity changes

review.reason: Reports transforms, dimensions, opacity, z-index, clip-path, and culling registration being applied only to the initial wrapper element when a custom ShapeWrapper changes identity. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same pluggable ShapeWrapper component API; its canvas uses its own compositor and overlays rather than React shape wrappers. The specific remount/culling path has no direct equivalent.

title: Captured-pointer Firefox workaround re-types any matching pointer_up as a left-button release

review.reason: Reports a Firefox-specific recovery path rewriting a later right/middle-button release as a left-button release when the original captured left-button release was lost. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not rewrite a pointerup button based only on a captured pointer id. Its input pipeline checks `button` at pointerdown and keeps contact ownership separately; the exact Firefox workaround and stale capturedPointerId path are not present.

title: Let custom shapes opt in to label-first hit testing instead of hard-coding note, arrow and hollow geo

review.reason: Requests an opt-in shape utility hook for label-first hit testing instead of hard-coding note, arrow, and hollow-geo types. This changes the upstream custom-shape extension API and overlap priority.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same pluggable ShapeUtil/custom-shape registry; its shape and text hit testing are implemented against its own scene-node model. The requested extension hook has no direct API counterpart.

title: Let child shapes opt out of frame clipping instead of exempting the arrow type by name

review.reason: Requests a child-side custom-shape opt-out from frame clipping rather than exempting arrows by package type. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The issue depends on tldraw frame-like ShapeUtil inheritance and external custom connector types. Varve has no equivalent custom ShapeUtil extension boundary, so the proposed API does not transfer directly.

title: Custom shapes that use editor component contexts are silently dropped from exports

review.reason: Reports an upstream SVG export provider missing component contexts, causing custom React shape components to throw inside an error boundary and disappear silently.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve exports serialized scene/IR nodes through engine serializers and renderers; it does not ask arbitrary React shape components to render inside SVG export. This provider-context failure path is not shared.

title: Make PerformanceManager extend EditorManager

review.reason: Requests adoption of the upstream EditorManager disposal contract for PerformanceManager while acknowledging that subscriber-driven lazy listeners need separate attach/detach handling.

varveAssessment.assessment: The tldraw manager base class and lazy listener ownership model are package-specific; no direct class migration is indicated in Varve.

title: Timers never prunes fired or cleared timer ids, so editor.timers grows without bound

review.reason: Reports tldraw Timers retaining every fired or cleared timer ID for the editor lifetime, with repeated array copies making timer registration quadratic. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comparable editor-wide timer registry accumulating IDs. In the canvas input pipeline, lifecycle timers are held in individual refs, cleared/replaced, and nulled on fire or effect cleanup. This exact unbounded collection and quadratic append path is absent.

title: Extract a shared helper for the repeated TLShapeId[] | TLShape[] to ids normalisation in Editor.ts

review.reason: Requests centralizing a repeated TLShapeId[]/TLShape[] normalization helper in upstream Editor.ts; the described issue is maintenance drift rather than an observed user-facing failure.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s selection-arrangement and scene APIs consume node IDs through their own document model. The TypeScript union and 22 repeated upstream conversion sites have no direct equivalent.

title: Deduplicate the axis-specific gap snapping code in BoundsSnaps

review.reason: Reports duplicated horizontal/vertical gap-snap logic in the tldraw SDK that had already drifted in boundary and duplicate-gap behavior; the requested follow-up is structural deduplication.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s snapping is already implemented in a dedicated module with shared axis-aware helpers, and existing snapping tests exercise horizontal and vertical behavior. No matching pair of duplicated 130-line gap algorithms was identified; avoid a speculative refactor of the interaction path.

title: Table-drive the modifier key debounce handling in Editor.ts

review.reason: Requests table-driven modifier debounce handling after duplicated Shift/Alt/Ctrl/Meta paths diverged in key naming and special cases. The issue is upstream refactoring with potential input semantics.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses a different normalized keyboard-input pipeline and does not carry the four tldraw Editor timeout fields/method copies. No direct refactor is indicated.

title: Share the translate-by-page-delta helper across the layout commands in Editor.ts

review.reason: Requests centralizing repeated page-space translation and axis mapping across seven tldraw layout commands; the duplication has a repeated TODO but no direct defect claim.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s align and distribute operations are already centralized in `packages/editor/src/scene/selectionArrangement.ts`, with an axis argument and shared geometry helpers. This upstream duplication pattern is already avoided in the matching local workflow.

title: Deep review of apps/dotcom for correctness bugs

review.reason: Rolls up fixes across tldraw.com sync workers, routes, Zero client handling, authentication, deletion, analytics, and rendering. The two comments say all child PRs merged except #10302 (closed because its route had no caller); a separate MCP render-token URL-length follow-up is tracked in #10967.

varveAssessment.assessment: The rollup is primarily about tldraw.com hosted sync/auth and service routes, which Varve does not operate. The MCP render-token URL follow-up has no current Varve endpoint analogue.

title: Deep review of @tldraw/editor for correctness bugs

review.reason: Rolls up regression-tested fixes across hit testing, geometry, camera, layout, pointer input, mount lifecycle, snapping, persistence, and exports. Its child fixes are separate source/evidence nodes and are not assumed complete from the parent summary.

varveAssessment.assessment: The rollup covers Varve-adjacent editor boundaries, and the child reports #10392–#10399 provide concrete local comparison leads. Continue recursively over linked fixes and compare each relevant invariant with Varve instead of importing the rollup as a single conclusion.

title: Sidebar toggle button hit area doesn't match its icon when the sidebar is closed

review.reason: Reports a mismatch between the visible sidebar icon and its clickable area only when reopening the tldraw.com sidebar. The sole comment attributes the behavior to a browser extension.

varveAssessment.assessment: A hosted tldraw.com sidebar report attributed to a browser extension is not evidence of a Varve sidebar defect; no local change is indicated.

title: Draw tool Shift segment switch threshold scales with zoom

review.reason: Reports a Shift-assisted draw segment switching threshold measured in canvas units. The author measured 2 CSS px at 25% zoom and 5 CSS px at 100%, and asked for a higher-zoom manual confirmation. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s `BaseTool` drag threshold and PenTool handle motion compare CSS-pixel event deltas, consistent with the project’s screen-space threshold rule. Varve PencilTool has no matching Shift/freehand segment-switch mode, so the specific transition cannot be reproduced locally.

title: Canvas ignores pointercancel, so interrupted touch gestures stay stuck

review.reason: Identifies the absence of `pointercancel` in the upstream canvas input set and the resulting stuck drag/stroke/navigation state. This was a code-review finding from a specified commit and was explicitly not yet browser-confirmed in its source.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve routes `onPointerCancel` through `inputPipeline.ts` to cancel active tool transactions and pointer ownership. A focused Playwright regression now dispatches a pen pointercancel, checks that no provisional shape remains, then confirms a fresh stroke commits. Targeted validation is pending.

title: Pinching during a select tool drag still moves shapes after the fingers lift

review.reason: Reports selection translate/resize/rotate and brush states ignoring the interrupt when a second touch starts a pinch, then resuming from stale gesture state after fingers lift. The source text says this report was code-derived and not browser-confirmed at the referenced commit.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s `inputPolicy.ts` transfers a second touch into navigation and asks the adapter to cancel the owned tool pointer; `SelectTool.onDragCancel` aborts the move transaction and clears previews. Current automated touch coverage checks stroke cancellation and pinch handoff, but not an in-progress selection transform; a dedicated real-interaction regression remains a candidate.

title: Selection action shortcuts run mid-drag instead of waiting for the gesture to end

review.reason: Reports Delete, lock, grouping, alignment, and other selection shortcuts mutating the active selection mid-gesture, causing stale movement or extra undo entries. The suggested resolution is to defer the action or cancel the gesture first. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve exposes `cancelCanvasInteraction` for rolling back an active canvas gesture, but `useShortcuts.ts` currently dispatches global selection actions without an explicit gesture guard. This is a concrete local regression candidate; reproduce with a real drag and Delete/align shortcut before selecting a safe cancellation boundary.

title: Space+arrow and Alt+arrow also nudge the selected shapes

review.reason: Reports Space+arrow camera pan or Alt+arrow page navigation also reaching the selection tool and nudging shapes. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve handles Space by arming Hand and returning; Hand arrow panning is handled before generic nudge. `CanvasNudgeController` explicitly finishes and rejects Alt/Ctrl/Meta arrows. No matching double-effect path was found in source.

title: A pen is treated as a coarse pointer

review.reason: Reports any pen interaction switching a hybrid tablet into coarse touch mode and reducing precision controls. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve automatic tablet layout requires touch capability without a fine pointer; observing a pen contact alone does not select tablet layout. Hit-test touch margins are keyed to actual touch input, while pen events retain pen-specific pressure and precision behavior.

title: Edge-scroll delay and ramp carry over between gestures

review.reason: Reports the next drag starting at full edge-scroll velocity when the prior drag ended inside the edge band, because the upstream manager retains delay/ramp state. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s canvas auto-pan loop has no inter-gesture delay/ramp state: `stopAutoPan` cancels the scheduled frame and resets active state, velocity, and last frame time, and is called on pointer up/cancel. The described carry-over state is absent.

title: Shift-click after a page change edits a shape on the old page

review.reason: Reports Shift-click continuation appending to a prior page’s shape after the user changes pages without changing tools. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s PencilTool commits a new path on each gesture and has no Shift-click continuation mode that retains a prior shape across page changes. The specific stale continuation reference is absent.

title: Switching tools during a text drag leaves an invisible text shape

review.reason: Reports a fixed-width text box left behind when the text tool is switched while a drag is active. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve `setTool` cancels the current canvas interaction before applying the tool change. `TextTool.onDragCancel` clears only the draft; text nodes are created on drag end, so a mid-drag switch cannot commit the empty box.

title: Switching tools during an arrow press leaves a stub arrow

review.reason: Reports an arrow created immediately on pointerdown remaining after the arrow tool is switched before the user moves. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve tool changes cancel the active canvas gesture first. `ArrowTool.onDragCancel` clears the draft, while the committed shape is created only on drag end; the reported press-then-switch artifact has no matching local path.

title: Escape after dragging a note from a clone handle keeps the note and switches tools

review.reason: Reports Escape during a tldraw note clone-handle drag keeping the newly created note and switching tools; the sole comment confirms fix #10187 sets a history mark before creation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no note clone-handle gesture; note creation and duplication use other tool paths. This upstream history-mark fix does not directly transfer.

title: Escape during a crop drag reverts the whole crop session

review.reason: Reports Escape during a tldraw crop handle/picture drag consuming the crop session stopping point and reverting all prior crop adjustments, while leaving crop mode inconsistent.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve CropTool stages all crop adjustments in transient crop state and applies them only on Enter/Apply. Escape exits crop mode and discards the complete uncommitted session. That is a different interaction contract; the upstream partial-drag rollback expectation is not imported without a product-level need for per-drag crop checkpoints.

title: Escape in image crop mode also clears the selection

review.reason: Reports Escape in tldraw image crop mode firing cancellation twice and clearing selection, unlike clicking outside the crop.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve CropTool Escape switches to Select without clearing the current selection, and the tool handler consumes the key before generic Escape handling. The duplicate-cancel and bubbling path described upstream is not present in the local handler.

title: A label drag on a deleted arrow leaves the select tool stuck

review.reason: Reports a label-drag release returning early when the arrow was deleted during the gesture, leaving selection stuck; the sole comment confirms fix #10183 always exits the pointing state.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not support the same hosted collaborative deletion path. A local delete shortcut during a canvas gesture is separately being evaluated under #10396; the report is kept linked as additional stale-selection-state context.

title: Duplicating a page moves its shapes

review.reason: Reports tldraw page duplication using viewport-aware paste positioning and shifting content that was offscreen instead of preserving page coordinates. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve `duplicatePage` is a scene-level page operation that deep-copies page content and its node positions; it does not call viewport-aware paste placement. Existing page duplication tests cover copy ownership and content.

title: Editing one embed makes every embed interactive

review.reason: Reports tldraw’s editing-one-embed state allowing pointer interaction on every embed on the page, so an unselected second embed takes the click. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve embeds are represented as document content and are not live interactive iframe components on the canvas; this interaction ownership state is not shared.

title: "Unlock all" marks no undo stopping point

review.reason: Reports tldraw Unlock All mutating shapes without marking an undo boundary, causing one undo to revert an earlier unrelated change too. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve layer bulk locking wraps the mutation in `groupCompoundOperation`, which establishes the single undo boundary. The corresponding guide-only lock toggle is a separate operation. No missing stopping point was found in the matching bulk-layer workflow.

title: Changing an arrowhead doesn't create its own undo step

review.reason: Reports an arrowhead style change merging into the prior selection history step. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve behavior change is inferred from this single upstream style-history report. Compare the local arrowhead control and document history semantics in the targeted style/history audit.

title: Keyboard changes to the opacity slider don't mark an undo stopping point

review.reason: Reports keyboard operations on the opacity slider not starting a separate undo step, unlike pointer interaction. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses its own NumberField/range controls and document-history transactions; this upstream slider event path is not directly transferable without local interaction evidence.

title: Undo reverts the previous edit after brushing, right-click deselect, Enter on groups, or keyboard traversal

review.reason: Reports several tldraw selection changes not creating their own stopping point, so Undo reverts an earlier document edit. The report is specific to tldraw’s history model where selection is captured with history.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve tracks selection refinement separately from document history and its updateDoc contract preserves selection stacks; the selection-only undo behavior differs. No matching four-case path is established by this report.

title: Undo after switching pages also reverts the previous edit

review.reason: Reports page navigation being merged into an earlier tldraw edit, causing one Undo to both revert the edit and switch pages. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve page navigation calls `setActivePage`, which updates the document through `updateDoc`; outside an explicit compound transaction, updateDoc creates its own undo snapshot. Page navigation therefore has a distinct history entry.

title: Undo after dropping a file also undoes the previous change

review.reason: Reports a file dropped on the canvas and the previous unmarked change being undone together. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve file drops flow through its import/batch insertion path and document transaction model, distinct from tldraw’s asset insertion API. Compare with local import history tests before any change.

title: Undo after saving alt text also undoes the previous action

review.reason: Reports image alt-text changes folding into a prior action without a separate stopping point. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve image descriptions are document node properties updated through its own editor context. The report identifies a useful local history scenario but does not establish a matching defect.

title: Alt+double-click rectangle/check-box swap is not a separate undo step

review.reason: Reports an Alt+double-click rectangle/check-box type swap being merged into the prior selection step. This is a tldraw-specific easter egg.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no matching Alt+double-click rectangle/check-box swap interaction.

title: Only the left Shift key gives the large nudge step

review.reason: Reports tldraw checking physical ShiftLeft instead of the logical Shift state, so right Shift does not select the large nudge step. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s nudge step reads the normalized `KeyboardEvent.shiftKey` state rather than testing a physical left-side key code, so either Shift key selects the large step.

title: Holding Z for the zoom tool clears the toolbar's active tool highlight

review.reason: Reports holding Z for the temporary Zoom tool clearing the toolbar highlight for the underlying tool. The sole comment confirms upstream fix #10185.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s spring-loaded Hand tool keeps the persistent tool selection separate from temporary navigation state; no matching temporary Zoom tool/highlight path is identified here.

title: Delete key deletes a child of a locked frame while the menu item is disabled

review.reason: Reports the Delete keyboard shortcut removing a child of a locked frame even though the context menu disables deletion. The sole comment confirms fix #10334 checks locked ancestors.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve `removeSelected` filters selected nodes through `isNodeEffectivelyLocked`, which walks ancestor locks before deletion. Keyboard deletion and menu deletion share this command path.

title: Locking a mixed selection keeps it selected

review.reason: Reports tldraw locking all items in a mixed locked/unlocked selection while leaving now-locked items selected, unlike the all-unlocked path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve exposes explicit bulk lock/unlock from the Layers panel rather than this Shift+L toggle contract. No matching mixed-selection lock action is established.

title: Tab and Ctrl/Cmd+arrow traversal visit locked shapes

review.reason: Reports Tab and Ctrl/Cmd+arrow traversal selecting locked tldraw shapes even though click and select-all skip them. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve Tab traversal builds its ordered candidates by walking all active-page roots without filtering effective ancestor locks, while canvas hit testing and delete actions treat locked nodes specially. Add a focused keyboard-navigation regression and decide consistent locked-node traversal semantics.

title: "Frame selection" shortcut does nothing on Windows and Linux

review.reason: Reports a documented tldraw Frame Selection accelerator defined only as Cmd+Alt+G and unavailable on Windows/Linux. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s shortcut definitions do not advertise or expose a matching Frame Selection command, so this platform-specific missing twin is not currently a local broken promise.

title: Context-menu paste lands under the pointer, not at the right-click point

review.reason: Reports Paste using the current pointer position after the user moved through a context menu instead of the original right-click location. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve anchors the canvas context menu at the original viewport point and captures invocation document/page/selection; its paste command uses the canvas cursor position retained from the right-click. The current pointer leaves the canvas while the menu is used, so no local mismatch was established by source review.

title: Pasted text and bookmarks are not selected

review.reason: Reports plain-text and bookmark paste paths not selecting their new shapes, unlike other paste types. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s clipboard import tests explicitly assert selection for pasted rich text and inserted nodes. URL/bookmark paste is not a distinct supported bookmark-node path in Varve, so the upstream omission does not match.

title: Handle drags ignore the Ctrl/Cmd grid override and apply the grid after shape snapping

review.reason: Reports line/arrow endpoint handle drags ignoring Ctrl/Cmd grid override and allowing grid snapping to displace an object snap. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve selection resize handles pass `bypassSnap` to TransformEngine, which suppresses the snap callback for Ctrl/Cmd; the dedicated line endpoint editor adjusts local points directly and has no competing grid/object snap sequence. The exact upstream ordering defect was not found.

title: Shift segment threshold in the draw and highlight tools scales with zoom

review.reason: Reports Shift segment switching using page-space distance, producing 32 CSS px at 800% zoom. The sole comment confirms fix #10240 changed it to screen-space distance.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve PencilTool does not switch between freehand and straight segments during a stroke; PenTool constraints use event-space deltas. The local project also explicitly requires hand-scale thresholds to remain in CSS pixels.

title: Note tool doesn't snap a new note beside the note it just created

review.reason: Reports the note adjacency solver excluding a selected note left selected by tool lock, so a second note does not snap beside it. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent sticky-note adjacency slot solver or tool-lock continuation workflow.

title: Camera doesn't pan to the new note created with Tab or the clone handle

review.reason: Reports viewport framing the source note rather than the newly created note after Tab/clone-handle creation. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no adjacent-note Tab or clone-handle creation interaction, so this viewport-selection timing issue has no matching feature path.

title: Escape during a scribble selection drops the prior selection

review.reason: Reports Escape during tldraw scribble selection clearing the prior selection unlike rectangle brush cancellation. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve defers marquee selection until pointer-up; SelectTool Escape calls `onDragCancel` and consumes the key while a marquee is active, leaving the committed selection untouched. Scribble selection has no separate state path.

title: Ctrl/Cmd on a resize or rotate handle starts a brush with the wrong cursor

review.reason: Reports tldraw routing accelerator presses on transform handles into brush mode while retaining the transform cursor. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no matching handle-to-brush accelerator route; its selection transform and brush interactions are separate. This cursor-state report does not identify a matching Varve path.

title: A bookmark is left behind when resizing a multi-selection

review.reason: Reports a fixed-size bookmark omitted from a multi-selection resize snapshot, while other fixed-size content moves with the selection. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's scene model has no bookmark/embed node corresponding to the reported fixed-size shape utility; do not infer a general multi-selection transform defect from this upstream-specific omission.

title: Highlighter strokes inside a frame render faint

review.reason: Reports that tldraw's two-pass highlighter underlay is obscured by opaque frame backgrounds. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's highlighter is rendered through its own stroke/render path rather than a separate background pass; the specific frame-background compositing failure has no matching implementation path.

title: "Send to back" has no effect on an arrow bound to a shape

review.reason: Reports bound arrows being restacked above their bound shapes after an explicit send-to-back action; the sole comment calls this a decision rather than a bug.

varveAssessment.assessment: The maintainer explicitly classifies this as a product decision. Varve's scene arrow binding does not promise tldraw's automatic restacking contract, so this is not a Varve defect.

title: Arrow label drag reverts when a menu opens or undo is pressed mid-drag

review.reason: Reports a label-position drag being cancelled on gesture completion when a menu opens or undo occurs. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's arrow node currently has no independently draggable label-position interaction matching this state path; the specific rollback defect is not transferable.

title: Pressing Enter starts cropping an image in a readonly room

review.reason: Reports Enter entering crop state in a hosted readonly session. Reproduction requires a sync server and no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly-room collaboration mode, so the permission-state scenario is outside the current product boundary.

title: Exiting crop mode without cancelling leaves the image marked as the cropping shape

review.reason: Reports tldraw crop state retaining a global cropping-shape marker when leaving by tool/page/duplicate routes. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's CropTool.onDeactivate clears its transient crop state, node id, and node size on every tool exit, so the reported stale marker lifecycle does not match Varve's implementation.

title: Deleting a frame deletes its locked children

review.reason: Reports recursive deletion of locked descendants while deleting an unlocked parent; the upstream report explicitly says expected detached-child versus refusal semantics are unresolved.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's scene removal is recursive, but changing it to preserve locked descendants would require defining valid parent detachment and undo semantics across all containers. The source report leaves that product decision open, so no mutation is justified from this comparison alone.

title: Undecodable image file aborts the whole file drop with no error toast

review.reason: Reports one malformed image aborting a mixed tldraw file drop before valid siblings are committed. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's ImportService.importFiles invokes a per-file importer that converts parser/decode exceptions into a failed file report, continues the worker queue, and preserves report order; CanvasArea commits the valid artifacts and announces failures. The failure isolation is already present.

title: Edit link dialog becomes an empty panel when its shape is deleted or deselected

review.reason: Reports an edit-link dialog becoming empty after its selected shape disappears through collaboration or another input path. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent edit-link dialog tied to a remotely mutable selected shape; the collaboration-dependent dialog lifecycle is outside its current feature set.

title: Camera coasting and edge scrolling move twice as fast on high-refresh displays

review.reason: Reports frame-count-based camera coast and edge-scroll motion whose speed scales with refresh rate. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve integrates hand inertia and edge scrolling using elapsed-frame time through navigationFrameDeltaMs and the navigation physics helpers, avoiding the reported fixed-per-tick speed scaling.

title: Wheel events over the minimap are applied twice

review.reason: Reports a minimap wheel dispatch combined with a container's pass-through redispatch, applying one gesture twice. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's MinimapPanel has pointer-based navigation and no wheel forwarding or canvas redispatch handler, so the duplicate wheel path described upstream is absent.

title: Held keys are not cleared when the window loses focus

review.reason: Reports missed keyup events after application/window focus loss leaving modifiers and temporary navigation active. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve cancels canvas interactions on window blur and document visibility loss; ToolManager resets modifiers and the generic nudge controller finishes on focus loss. The upstream stale-key contract already has local safeguards.

title: Toolbar does not hide while editing text on mobile

review.reason: Reports an upstream mobile editing flag that is written but never consumed by its stylesheet. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses its own responsive workspace and text-edit overlays rather than the described layout data attribute and toolbar CSS contract; no same stale-flag defect is established by this report.

title: Screen-reader announcements say "tool.group" and "0 of N"

review.reason: Reports untranslated group type keys and top-level-only position indexing in tldraw's selection announcements. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's CanvasAnnouncer builds human-readable node-kind and name messages and does not report ordinal positions, so it avoids the raw key/0-of-N failures. Nested reading-order and group naming remain a broader accessibility opportunity, not a demonstrated regression from this issue.

title: Actions menu opens empty in readonly mode with the hand and zoom tools

review.reason: Reports a toolbar/actions-menu inconsistency in hosted readonly rooms. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly collaboration mode, so the room-permission branch and empty collaborative actions grid do not map to a current product path.

title: Escape ends a Space pan while Space is still held

review.reason: Reports Escape cancelling a held Space-pan gesture even though the temporary hand key remains down. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve treats Escape as cancellation of the active canvas gesture, while its spring-loaded Hand tool remains armed until Space keyup. This is an interaction-contract choice rather than an evident stale state; do not make Escape preserve a drag without revising the documented cancellation semantics.

title: Opening a menu or pressing undo mid-press creates a shape in some tools but not others

review.reason: Reports inconsistent tldraw tool outcomes when a press-only gesture receives a completion event before pointerup. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve separates pointer cancellation from normal pointerup and individual creation tools own their commit paths. The upstream state-machine divergence does not itself establish that Varve commits an unwanted default shape when a menu or undo interrupts a press; targeted reproduction would be needed before changing gesture completion semantics.

title: Eraser: pressing a frame's outline and dragging may or may not erase the frame

review.reason: Reports tldraw vector eraser frame-border hit behavior depending on whether the drag begins inside or outside the frame. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's eraser is a raster paint/mask tool and has no corresponding vector-frame eraser selection behavior, so the reported press-origin ambiguity is outside its current implementation.

title: Laser trail stays visible after changing page

review.reason: Reports transient laser trails surviving a page switch because the upstream scribble manager does not associate trails with pages. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not currently ship a laser presentation tool or page-agnostic transient laser trail manager, so there is no matching state lifecycle to repair.

title: Alt does not suppress Shift/Ctrl additive selection when releasing over a selected shape

review.reason: Reports tldraw applying different additive-selection modifier rules on pointer release depending on the release target. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve latches pointer modifiers for a gesture and uses selectionOperationFromModifiers for selection changes. This report is specifically a down-versus-up modifier inconsistency in tldraw; no matching Varve release branch has been reproduced.

title: Malformed deep links move the camera to the origin instead of falling back

review.reason: Reports malformed serialized viewport links reaching camera update with invalid coordinates rather than the documented fallback. Missing parameter behavior is separately a design question. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's navigation target parser validates viewport zoom and pan values and returns a structured invalid-target result for malformed links; existing navigationTargets tests cover malformed and hostile input. No invalid camera fallback path matching this report was found.

title: Follow tooltip says "Following", Windows shortcuts mix Ctrl and ⇧, and the shortcuts preference only disables some keys

review.reason: Combines a hosted follow tooltip, Windows glyph formatting, and inconsistent effects from tldraw's keyboard-shortcut preference. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no follow/collaboration control or matching global shortcuts-disable preference. Its shortcut reference and platform labels are built from Varve's own shortcut model, so this combined upstream report does not identify a shared failure path.

title: Up to 350 ms of edits are lost when a tab closes or reloads

review.reason: The issue describes a plausible but unconfirmed loss during tldraw's 350 ms TLLocalSyncClient throttle. The linked upstream fix adds lifecycle flushes that Varve already has. Varve's browser termination save is asynchronous and recovery waits for its idle threshold, but this batch did not reproduce loss or establish a concrete defect. Preserve as a durability edge for later real-browser testing; do not port the fix without evidence.

varveAssessment.tests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/editor/src/lifecycle/__tests__/coordinator.test.ts packages/editor/src/lifecycle/__tests__/pageHideBoundary.test.ts packages/editor/src/persistence/lifecycleFlush.test.ts packages/editor/src/autoSaveService.test.ts packages/editor/src/recovery.test.ts --reporter=dot — 5 files, 90 tests passed; browser forced-shutdown behavior not covered.
varveAssessment.remainingQuestion: Does a real browser persist the last edit when forced to terminate before asynchronous lifecycle and idle recovery writes complete?

title: Drawings are lost when `/develop` and another example share the `example` persistence key

review.reason: Reports two tldraw example routes sharing one browser persistence key while registering incompatible schemas, causing one-way sync and document overwrite. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's document tabs and local persistence do not share this example-route persistenceKey/schema-migration arrangement, and there is no corresponding cross-tab document synchronization path to reproduce.

title: Hard reset deletes every tldraw document on the origin without confirmation, and stalls when another tab is open

review.reason: Reports an origin-wide destructive database reset without confirmation and an IndexedDB connection-blocking stall. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The described debug-menu hard reset and shared tldraw database registry are specific to upstream developer examples; this does not establish a matching Varve user-flow or storage deletion path.

title: "Create 100 shapes" reuses ids after a reload and marks no stopping point

review.reason: Reports a tldraw developer menu fixture command reusing deterministic ids without an undo boundary or viewport-aware placement. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent create-100-shapes debug menu action; the fixture command's id, undo, and viewport-placement defects do not map to a current user workflow.

title: Turning keyboard shortcuts off also removes the way out of focus mode

review.reason: Reports a global disable preference suppressing both editing and recovery shortcuts while the dialog still presents them as active. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same global keyboard-shortcuts enable/disable preference or focus-mode escape dependency, so the reported inaccessible recovery route has no matching setting path.

title: Color scheme and reduce motion follow the operating system only some of the time

review.reason: Combines stale pre-mount system theme, non-reactive OS reduced-motion preference, and a shortcut that replaces System theme with explicit Light/Dark. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's theme runtime subscribes to live OS color-scheme and contrast changes while System is selected, and reduced-motion behavior has its own runtime manager; its theme control and shortcuts do not share the described tldraw paths. The specific three-part upstream regression is not established locally.

title: IndexedDB read-failure alert promises a reload that never happens

review.reason: Reports a tldraw IndexedDB read failure showing a reload promise without actually reloading; the write-failure path reloads. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's storage recovery path is handled through its persistence/lifecycle and backup service rather than the referenced TLLocalSyncClient alert flow. No corresponding read-failure message/action mismatch was demonstrated from this upstream report.

title: IndexedDB session state rows are never pruned

review.reason: Reports an unused pruning method in tldraw's exported LocalIndexedDb session store. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use tldraw's `session_state` object store or persist a row per browser tab through the same LocalIndexedDb abstraction; this maintenance issue does not establish a corresponding local row-growth defect.

title: Export background has two conflicting defaults in tlschema

review.reason: Reports two tldraw defaults that currently resolve to the same initial observable transparency state because the creator supplies an explicit value. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream latent schema-contract mismatch that the issue itself says has no current observable effect. Varve's export background is managed through its own explicit export options and does not share the cited tldraw instance-record defaults.

title: Debug flags panel has dead flags, a wrong slow-FPS threshold, and sticky hide shapes

review.reason: Reports unused toggles, refresh-rate-dependent FPS warning threshold, and a debug-mode-dependent hide-shapes flag that remains active after leaving the panel. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no matching tldraw debug flags panel or hideShapes toggle state machine. Its canvas diagnostics and frame timing use separate metrics, so the upstream dead-flag and threshold defects do not identify the same local path.

title: Auto input mode is mislabelled and note shadows are missing from dark-mode exports

review.reason: Combines a wheel input-mode label based on application configuration rather than device detection with a dark-export note-shadow report. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve labels wheel modes as explicit Auto/Pan/Zoom choices and the new invert-zoom preference describes the actual direction behavior; it does not label Auto as a detected mouse or trackpad. Varve has no tldraw note shape/shadow export path matching the second report.

title: Links cannot be added, edited, or removed on touch devices

review.reason: Reports a tldraw coarse-pointer path hiding its rich-text toolbar and therefore its inline link editor. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's rich-text editing and link controls are structured around its own text editing surfaces and link properties; the hidden DefaultRichTextToolbar/LinkEditor nesting described upstream is absent. Touch reachability of Varve's link workflows should be evaluated on its own interaction contract rather than inferred from this code path.

title: Rich text copy, paste, and link handling inconsistencies

review.reason: Aggregates tldraw plain-text list serialization, paste-time markdown, URL scheme defaults, shortcut casing, RTL list, and export inconsistencies. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The report spans separate upstream rich-text policies; Varve uses a different document/text representation and clipboard pipeline. No single Varve behavior can be inferred from the tldraw discrepancies, so retain individual product comparisons rather than porting the aggregate fix as a unit.

title: Outbox insert effect for a duplicated file hangs until parked with no error

review.reason: Describes a tldraw hosted outbox effect timing out while waiting for a shared Durable Object persist and a linked server-side bound/failure-stage fix. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve is a local-first editor and does not have the hosted shared-file outbox/R2 duplication path described; this incident is outside the current product boundary.

title: Add native Mermaid support for entity relationship diagrams (erDiagram)

review.reason: Requests editable entity and relationship shapes when Mermaid ER syntax is pasted; upstream currently inserts a static SVG for unsupported diagram types. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no Mermaid import/conversion feature or existing static-SVG fallback for Mermaid input, so this is a potential product feature rather than a local regression. It would require a defined diagram-import contract and entity/relationship node conversion.

title: Add PDF export for pages and whole files on tldraw.com

review.reason: Requests a single PDF with one page per design page using full page content bounds; the sole comment additionally requests PDF export from frames for presentation preparation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve already exports multi-page presentation slides as PDF, while native document PDF export is focused on print/output geometry. Whole-file design-page export and frame-as-PDF-page workflow are distinct feature requests and should be assessed against those existing products rather than treated as missing PDF support generally.

title: Add hexagonal grid option (flat-top and pointy-top)

review.reason: Requests flat-top and pointy-top hex grids for tabletop maps; grid snapping/shared-grid requirements remain open. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve supports document and isometric grid systems but not hexagonal grid geometry. This is a potential cross-cutting grid feature, not a bug fix; the user story and unresolved snap/consistency requirements need a separate scoped feature decision before implementation.

title: Export the TipTap extension surface from the SDK

review.reason: Requests public re-exports of the same TipTap primitives/extensions bundled by the tldraw SDK to avoid duplicate ProseMirror instances. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the described Tiptap configuration API or the tldraw SDK bundle boundary; the duplicate-ProseMirror dependency hazard is upstream-specific.

title: Let people rearrange the toolbar on tldraw.com

review.reason: Requests persistent tool ordering and hide/show or overflow assignment for tldraw.com, scoped away from its SDK. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's workspace customization already persists toolbar order, tool location (toolbar/flyout/hidden), and pinned tools per workspace mode; the functionality is documented in the workspaces guide.

title: Add snap points for arc arrows

review.reason: Requests configured edge, midpoint, and axis snap points for arc-arrow anchors, with pinned behavior when targets move. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's connector/arrow model has no corresponding arc-arrow anchor snapping contract; this is a potential connector feature rather than a local bug. The behavior when a bound target moves would need explicit product semantics before implementation.

title: Moving one child of a group reparents the entire group into or out of a frame

review.reason: Reports an upstream helper substituting the parent group whenever any child is being reparented, despite its comment saying the group moves only when all children move. The issue itself leaves intended semantics open.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's selection and explicit drop/reparent paths operate on selected root IDs through its own parent-preserving scene operations; this upstream kickoutOccludedShapes algorithm and its group-substitution rule have no direct equivalent. Keep the product ambiguity rather than changing hierarchy semantics without a local reproduction.

title: Arc2d.hitTestLineSegment reports hits for circle crossings outside the arc

review.reason: Reports angle normalization clamping off-arc circle intersections into valid arc endpoints, causing false hit results. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no corresponding Arc2d primitive exposing this circle-intersection and angle-parameter path; the reported geometry defect is upstream-specific.

title: Geometry2d.distanceToLineSegment measures from vertices instead of edges

review.reason: The body duplicates #10554's Arc2d hit-test report, while the title was mistakenly copied from #10556. Its sole comment confirms it is a duplicate and points to #10554/#10556 as the distinct issues.

varveAssessment.assessment: The issue comment resolves the body/title mismatch: record this as a duplicate of #10554, not a second distance-to-edge defect. Varve's shared pointToSegmentDistSq computes distance to the segment itself, including the edge interior.

title: Geometry2d.distanceToLineSegment measures from vertices instead of edges

review.reason: Reports distance calculated from polygon vertices rather than edge interiors. One comment cites an open proposed fix; the later maintainer comment closes the issue as not planned.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's `pointToSegmentDistSq` projects onto and clamps to the full segment, so its geometry utility does not share the vertex-only distance behavior. The later upstream closure is recorded; the earlier draft PR does not establish a current upstream fix.

title: getCurrentTheme returns undefined after setting an unregistered theme id

review.reason: Reports a public SDK ThemeManager storing an unknown theme id and later returning undefined; the comment says a PR was opened to reject unknown ids. No later merge confirmation appears in the accessible discussion.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's runtime theme preference accepts only the closed `system|light|dark|high-contrast` union and normalizes unknown persisted values to System. It does not expose the tldraw custom ThemeManager id setter/getter API described here.

title: Shapes hidden with getShapeVisibility still act as snap targets

review.reason: Reports hidden shapes remaining in tldraw object snapping; both comments confirm that PR #10331 fixed it and the separate locked-target question was left open.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's selection snapping targets pages, guides, and layout segments rather than arbitrary neighboring object edges, so the reported hidden-object target collection is absent. The upstream maintainer explicitly separates the unresolved locked-target policy from the fixed hidden-shape bug.

title: selectAdjacentShape('prev') with nothing selected skips to the second-to-last shape

review.reason: Reports previous-shape navigation wrapping to the penultimate shape with no selection; a comment says PR #10601 fixes the seed index. The other comment requests resolution.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve deliberately lets Tab with no canvas selection fall through to browser focus navigation so the canvas is never a keyboard trap; it does not implement tldraw's selectAdjacentShape API. The corrected upstream index behavior therefore has no direct local analogue.

title: selectAdjacentShape('prev') with no selection picks the second-to-last shape

review.reason: Repeats #10559's no-selection previous-navigation index report; the sole comment confirms PR #10601 covers both issues.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream duplicate of #10559, and Varve intentionally leaves Tab available for browser focus navigation when no canvas node is selected; no local selectAdjacentShape API has the reported index path.

title: getSvgPathData permanently rounds a geometry's stored points to two decimals

review.reason: Reports tldraw geometry methods calling mutating Vec.toFixed() while generating SVG path strings; a comment says a PR was opened to remove those calls and add regressions.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use the cited mutable Vec geometry primitive or `getSvgPathData` methods for cached shape geometry. Its scene points are plain immutable-by-convention records and path serialization does not share the reported mutating call site.

title: Group2d.transform drops ignored children and geometry options

review.reason: Reports an upstream Group2d transform omitting ignored children, flags, and transform options; the comment says PR #10603 fixes those omissions.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve scene grouping is represented by document node hierarchies and affine transforms, not the upstream `Geometry2d`/`Group2d` primitive. The reported debug-geometry and transform-option loss has no matching local transform method.

title: Context menu stops reopening after left-click dismiss with radix-ui 1.5.x

review.reason: Reports a reproduction tied to a newer radix-ui version and proposes controlled-root compatibility or a narrower dependency range. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not depend on the cited radix-ui context-menu package/version range or use its root component for the canvas context menu, so this dependency regression cannot affect the current path.

title: License key with non-ASCII payload fails verification with "Invalid signature"

review.reason: Reports a signing/verifying encoding disagreement for non-ASCII tldraw SDK license-key payloads, with existing ASCII keys as a compatibility concern. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no signed license-key mint/verification pipeline accepting arbitrary payload text, so the Latin-1 versus UTF-8 signature mismatch is outside its current product surface.

title: Reduce the tldraw bundle size

review.reason: A measured SDK bundle-size plan covers tree shaking, lazy rich text, dependency removal, and size budgets; the comment records the results and blockers of linked PRs #10573–#10575.

varveAssessment.assessment: The report concerns the published tldraw SDK barrel and its tree-shaking/chunking contract. Varve is a multi-app workspace with native/wasm consumers and package boundaries that require its own measured bundle budgets; these upstream numbers do not identify a local regression.

title: Rename the shared render pipeline internals from thumbnail to screenshot

review.reason: Requests internal screenshot naming for a hosted shared pipeline serving both OG thumbnails and MCP shape-cluster captures while keeping wire-visible names stable; the comment agrees and defers to a dependency landing.

varveAssessment.assessment: The shared edge render job and MCP cluster-capture service are hosted tldraw infrastructure, not Varve's local scene renderer. No matching naming-only change is warranted in Varve's distinct render pipeline.

title: Connecting to shared whiteboard, note text issue

review.reason: Reports guest collaborators' note edits being rejected/rolled back; one commenter offers to reproduce and investigate, while the later comment says #10824 fixed signed-out guest note attribution and asks whether signed-in users still reproduce it.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no shared whiteboard collaboration sessions or remote note-attribution permission path, so this incident and guest-specific upstream fix are outside the local-first product boundary.

title: Arrow labels wrap and get cut off in PNG exports
